Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Reproduction produces offspring of the same type. (i) Give the functions of the male and female reproductive systems. (ii) How is the reproductive system different from other organ systems? (4 marks)
(Reproduction se apni qisam ki aulad paida hoti hai. (i) Male aur female reproductive systems ke kaam batayein. (ii) Reproductive system doosre nizamon se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Reproduction jaandar ki apni qisam ki nayi aulad paida karne ki salahiyat hai.

(i) Kaam:
1. Dono nizam gametes banate aur fertilization ke liye tayyar karte hain.
2. Male nizam gametes female nizam tak pohanchata hai.
3. Female nizam fertilized egg ko ghiza aur bachche ki nashonuma ka mahol deta hai.

(ii) Doosre nizamon se farq:
1. Yeh mard aur aurat mein bohat mukhtalif hai, jab ke doosre nizam dono mein taqreeban aik jaise hain.
2. Yeh puberty tak kaam nahi karta, jab ke doosre nizam paidaish se ya foran baad kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The functions of reproductive systems include the production of reproductive cells (gametes)

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the position and internal structure of the testes, including the cells found in and between the seminiferous tubules and the importance of the scrotum. (4 marks)
(Testes ki jagah aur andaruni banawat bayan karein, seminiferous tubules ke andar aur darmiyan ke cells aur scrotum ki ahmiyat samait.)
blocks.explanation:
Jagah: do testes pait se bahar jild ki theli scrotum mein hain. Nashonuma mein yeh pait mein bante aur paidaish se kuch pehle scrotum mein utarte hain. Scrotum inhein taqreeban 34°C par rakhta hai, andaruni darje (37°C) se thora kam; yeh sperm ki nashonuma ke liye zaroori hai.

Banawat: har testis bayzavi, taqreeban 3–5 cm lamba aur 2–3 cm chora, bohat bal khai seminiferous tubules se bana.
1. Germinal epithelium (tubules ki deewar) mein do qisam ke cells:
a. Germline cells: meiosis se sperms banate hain.
b. Sertoli cells: sperms ko ghiza dete; in ki ratoobat sperms ko epididymis le jati; FSH se inhibin nikalte hain.
2. Leydig cells: tubules ke darmiyan interstitial tissue mein; LH se testosterone nikalte hain.
3. Tubules se sperms rete testis aur phir epididymis mein jate hain.

book_ref.quote: A testis is composed of highly convoluted seminiferous tubules

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the process of spermatogenesis, showing the chromosome number at each stage. (4 marks)
(Spermatogenesis ka amal har marhale par chromosome number ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Spermatogenesis woh amal hai jis se testes ki seminiferous tubules mein sperms bante hain.
1. Tubules ki deewar ke germline cells (2n) mitosis se taqseem hote hain. Kuch naye cells spermatogonia (2n) bante, kuch aainda ke liye germline cells rehte hain.
2. Spermatogonia (2n) taqseem ho kar primary spermatocytes (2n) banate hain jo lumen ki taraf jate hain.
3. Har primary spermatocyte meiosis-I se do secondary spermatocytes (1n) banata hai.
4. Yeh jaldi meiosis-II se spermatids (1n) banate hain.
Is tarah aik spermatogonium (2n) se chaar spermatids (1n).
5. Har spermatid lamba sperm ban jata hai.
Control: FSH (GnRH ke zariye anterior pituitary se) seminiferous tubules ko spermatogenesis ke liye uksata hai.

book_ref.quote: In the walls of seminiferous tubules, special cells called germline cells (2n) divide by mitosis

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the structure of a mature sperm. How does it reach the epididymis and become motile? (4 marks)
(Pakke sperm ki banawat bayan karein. Yeh epididymis tak kaise pohanchta aur harkat ke qabil kaise hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: sperm ke teen hisse.
1. Head: genetic maddah. Is ka taqreeban do tihai hissa moti topi acrosome se dhaka hai jo zyada tar Golgi body se banti aur ovum ko fertilize karne wale enzymes rakhti hai.
2. Midpiece: mitochondria aur aik centriole.
3. Tail: midpiece ke centriole se nikalne wale microtubules (axial filament).

Pakna: seminiferous tubules ke lumen mein pakke sperms harkat nahi karte. Sertoli cells ki ratoobat ki madad se woh (rete testis se) epididymis jate hain. Wahan kam az kam 18 ghante reh kar harkat ke qabil hote aur phir vas deferens mein jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The genetic material is present within its head

blocks.prompt:
5 Explain how negative feedback keeps the levels of FSH and LH under control in the male. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke male mein negative feedback FSH aur LH ki miqdar ko kaise qaboo mein rakhta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Spermatogenesis hypothalamus aur pituitary ke hormones se control hoti hai.
1. Hypothalamus GnRH nikalta hai jo anterior pituitary se FSH aur LH nikalwata hai.
2. FSH seminiferous tubules ko spermatogenesis par uksata hai. FSH Sertoli cells se peptide hormone inhibin bhi nikalwata hai jo mazeed FSH rokta hai.
3. LH Leydig cells (interstitial tissue) se testosterone nikalwata hai. Testosterone germinal epithelium ki nashonuma aur mardana secondary jinsi khasoosiyat qaim rakhta hai.
4. Barhta testosterone LH aur GnRH ka nikalna rokta hai.
Yani har pituitary hormone aik cheez (inhibin ya testosterone) banwata hai jo usi hormone ko mazeed nikalne se rok deti hai: negative feedback.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, when LH stimulates Leydig cells to secrete testosterone

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Negative feedback thermostat jaisa hai: kamra garam ho jaye to heater khud band. Yahan FSH zyada → inhibin barhta → FSH kam. LH zyada → testosterone barhta → LH aur GnRH kam.

blocks.prompt:
6 Compare the male and female gonads with respect to position, size, structure and products. (4 marks)
(Mardana aur zanana gonads ka jagah, size, banawat aur paidawar ke lihaz se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Gonads testes (male) aur ovaries (female) hain. Muqabla table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: There are two ovaries – each present on the side of the uterus

Bohat se chhote theli numa ovarian follicles, kaam ki ikaai

blocks.prompt:
7 The ovary releases an egg each month. (i) Describe the ovary and its follicles. (ii) Describe the oviducts and the events that take place in them. (4 marks)
(Ovary har mahine anda chhorti hai. (i) Ovary aur us ke follicles bayan karein. (ii) Oviducts aur un mein hone wale waqiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Ovaries ande (ova ya oocytes) banati aur hormones nikalti hain. Do hain, uterus ke dono taraf; har aik bayzavi, 3-5 cm lambi, 2-3 cm chori. In mein bohat se chhote theli numa ovarian follicles hain jo ovary ki kaam ki ikaai hain aur kachchay ande paalte hain. Baligh aurat mein har mahine aik pakne wala follicle anda chhorta hai (ovulation). Phata follicle glandular corpus luteum ban jata hai.

(ii) Oviducts (fallopian ya uterine tubes) do naliyan hain jo ovaries se uterus tak jati hain.
1. Ovum pakne par follicle aur ovary ki deewar phat kar use chhorti hai aur woh oviduct mein jata hai.
2. Oviduct ki andaruni teh ke cilia ki harkat se woh uterus ki taraf chalta hai.
3. Fertilization oviduct mein hoti hai; wahan secondary oocyte meiosis-II mukammal karta hai.
4. Zygote oviduct mein hi kai mitotic taqseemein karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the parts of the uterus and the layers of its wall. How is the placenta formed? (4 marks)
(Uterus ke hisse aur us ki deewar ki tehein bayan karein. Placenta kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Uterus khokhla, muscle wala uzv hai jis mein dono oviducts khulti hain.

Hisse:
1. Fundus: oviducts ke munh ke upar sab se upar gol hissa.
2. Body: bara hissa.
3. Cervix: nichla tang hissa; is ka munh vagina (8-10 cm patli nali) mein khulta hai.

Deewar ki tehein:
1. Perimetrium: sab se bahar patli teh.
2. Myometrium: smooth muscles ki darmiyani moti teh.
3. Endometrium: andar ki spongy teh; basal teh (functional teh dobara banane wale stem cells) aur functional teh (har cycle mein moti ho kar utarti hai).

Placenta: hamal mein functional teh embryo ke implantation ke liye mazeed moti hoti; is ke vascular khane mil kar placenta banate hain jo embryo aur foetus ko oxygen aur ghiza deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The two oviducts enter into a hollow and muscular organ called uterus

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe oogenesis from the embryonic stage to the formation of the ovum. (4 marks)
(Oogenesis ko janeeni marhale se ovum banne tak bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Oogenesis (ovum banna) female ki janeeni nashonuma mein shuru hota hai.
1. Janeeni marhala: follicles ke oogonia (2n) mitosis se primary oocytes (2n) banate hain. Yeh meiosis-I shuru kar ke prophase-I mein ruk jate aur poore bachpan (kam az kam 10 se 14 saal) ruke rehte hain. Paidaish par ovaries mein taqreeban 2 million follicles, har aik mein primary oocyte.
2. Puberty: bohat se primary oocytes mein se sirf aik meiosis-I dobara shuru kar ke do na-barabar haploid cells banata hai: bara secondary oocyte (1n) aur chhota first polar body (1n).
3. Secondary oocyte metaphase-II mein ruk jata aur ovulation par ovary se oviduct mein chhora jata hai.
4. Fertilize na ho to mar jata hai. Sperm mile to oviduct mein jaldi meiosis-II mukammal kar ke aik bara ovum (1n) aur chhota second polar body (1n) banata hai.

book_ref.quote: In that period, the oogonia (2n) present in follicle divide by mitosis to produce primary oocytes (2n)

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the changes that take place in the ovary during one menstrual cycle. (4 marks)
(Aik menstrual cycle ke dauran ovary mein hone wali tabdeeliyan bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Menstrual phase (din 1-5): gonadotropins aur FSH barhna shuru.
2. Follicle ki nashonuma: FSH barhne se kuch follicles barhte hain magar sirf aik poora barhta aur baqi khatam. Yeh pakka Graafian follicle ovary ki satah par aata hai. FSH ise estrogen nikalne par uksata hai.
3. Ovulation (din 14): proliferative phase ke aakhir mein anterior pituitary se LH ka achanak nikalna Graafian follicle se ovum oviduct mein chhurwata hai.
4. Corpus luteum (din 15-28): ovulation ke baad LH phate Graafian follicle ko peeli banawat corpus luteum banata hai jo estrogen aur progesterone nikalta hai.
5. Fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam hota hai; ho to embryo ka hCG ise qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to the rise in FSH, few ovarian follicles begin growing

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the changes in the endometrium of the uterus during the three phases of the menstrual cycle, naming the hormones responsible. (4 marks)
(Menstrual cycle ke teen phases mein uterus ke endometrium ki tabdeeliyan zimmedar hormones ke naam ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Menstrual cycle taqreeban 28 din ka hai.
1. Menstrual phase (din 1-5): endometrium ki functional teh utarti; tissue aur khoon bahar (menstruation), 3-5 din. Wajah: estrogen aur progesterone kam.
2. Proliferative phase (din 6-14): Graafian follicle ka estrogen endometrium mein naliyan shuru karta aur use makhmali aur mota karta hai. Aakhir mein din 14 par ovulation.
3. Secretory/post-ovulatory phase (din 15-28): corpus luteum ke estrogen aur progesterone endometrium ko zyada naliyon wala aur glandular karte hain.
Cycle ka khatma: fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam, estrogen aur progesterone achanak girte aur mota endometrium khoon ke saath utarta (din 28 par menstruation). Basal teh ke stem cells baad mein functional teh dobara banate hain.

book_ref.quote: In this phase, the functional layer of endometrium is shed

blocks.prompt:
12 The fate of the corpus luteum decides whether menstruation occurs. (i) What happens when the ovulated oocyte is not fertilized? (ii) What happens when it is fertilized, and why is hCG used in pregnancy tests? (4 marks)
(Corpus luteum ka anjaam tay karta hai ke menstruation hoga ya nahi. (i) Ovulate shuda oocyte fertilize na ho to kya hota hai? (ii) Fertilize ho to kya hota hai, aur pregnancy test mein hCG kyun dekha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ovulation ke baad LH phate Graafian follicle ko peela corpus luteum banata hai jo estrogen aur progesterone nikal kar endometrium ko zyada naliyon wala aur glandular karta hai.

(i) Fertilize na ho: secondary oocyte mar jata hai. Corpus luteum khatam hona shuru hota aur anterior pituitary LH nahi nikalta. Corpus luteum ke khatme se estrogen aur progesterone achanak girte, mota endometrium khoon ke saath utarta: din 28 par menstruation aur naya cycle.

(ii) Fertilize ho: chhota embryo hCG nikalta hai jo corpus luteum qaim rakhta hai. Estrogen aur progesterone zyada rehte aur menstruation nahi hota; endometrium implantation ke liye mazeed mota ho kar placenta banata hai. hCG embryo ke chorion se aata hai, maa se nahi, is liye har pregnancy test mein yahi dekha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: When the ovulated oocyte is fertilized, the tiny embryo secretes human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG)
